title: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.14117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models have become the standard approach in language and vision. These models are typically pretrained first and then fine-tuned. Recent work demonstrates how to pretrain an autoregressive generative model on Level-3 order-flow data. However, to our knowledge, no one has fine-tuned such a model yet for downstream tasks.   Here we first pretrain a 300M-parameter generative model on Level-3 order-flow data collected from two crypto exchanges, Bitstamp and Bitfinex. Then we fine-tune the pretrained model to predict the microprice return and its realized volatility. We show that our fine-tuned model outperforms classical baselines, such as gradient boosting on handcrafted features, in predicting microprice returns over sub-second horizons. Furthermore, the predictive ability of the model transfers zero-shot to assets it was never fine-tuned on. Due to the short-term nature of these forecasts, the predicted microprice moves are sma

translated_title: 对订单流基础模型进行微调以实现亚秒级预测
translated_abstract: 生成模型已成为语言和视觉领域的标准方法。这些模型通常先进行预训练，然后进行微调。最近的研究展示了如何在Level-3订单流数据上预训练自回归生成模型。然而，据我们所知，目前还没有人对此类模型进行微调以应用于下游任务。本文首先在来自两个加密货币交易所（Bitstamp和Bitfinex）的Level-3订单流数据上预训练了一个3亿参数的生成模型。然后我们对预训练模型进行微调，以预测微价格收益率及其实现波动率。结果表明，我们微调后的模型在预测亚秒级时间跨度的微价格收益率方面优于传统基线方法，例如基于手工特征的梯度提升方法。此外，该模型的预测能力能够以零样本方式迁移到从未在其上进行过微调的资产。由于这些预测的短期性质，预测的微价格变动较小。
tldr: 本文首次对在加密货币交易所Level-3订单流数据上预训练的3亿参数生成模型进行微调，实现了亚秒级微价格收益率预测，性能超越传统基线方法，且预测能力可零样本迁移至未见过的资产。
